task: Estimate empirical rank-pattern frequencies, with exacta final-price conditioning where complete candidate quote books exist. No purchase selection.
interval: 95% Wilson score interval, approximate independent-binomial sampling interval only; not future assurance
price_bin_selection: Round reporting boundaries, fixed before this estimation run; not optimized for returns and not proposed purchase thresholds.
price_denominator: Every complete-book race in the cell where that specific rank-pair ticket has a quote in that bin, whether it wins or loses.
missing_quote_policy: Exclude from conditional-price estimates; never zero-fill. Report coverage.
trifecta_price_estimation: Not available from current local complete candidate-quote dataset; do not substitute winning payout-only data.
limitations: Previously viewed archive, not newly untouched validation.
Final quotes, not pre-purchase quote snapshots.
Historical group frequencies, not calibrated individual race probabilities.
No selection of profitable-looking patterns and no automatic promotion.
